paragraphs.text: translated by
1. MAY they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma-
paragraphs.original: उदीरतामवर उत्परास उन्मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः ।
paragraphs.translit: udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May they who have attained the life of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.
paragraphs.original: असुं य ईयुरवृका ऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु
paragraphs.translit: asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu

paragraphs.text: 2. Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed,
paragraphs.original: इदं पितृभ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो य उपरास ईयुः ।
paragraphs.translit: idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Those who have rested in the earthly region, and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.
paragraphs.original: ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषत्ता ये वा नूनं सुवृजनासु विक्षु
paragraphs.translit: ye pārthive rajasyā niṣattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu

paragraphs.text: 3. 1 have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, I have gained son and progeny from Visnu.
paragraphs.original: आहं पितॄन्सुविदत्राँ अवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः ।
paragraphs.translit: āhaṃ pitṝnsuvidatrām̐ avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ |

paragraphs.text: They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.
paragraphs.original: बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्त इहागमिष्ठाः
paragraphs.translit: barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come, help us: these offerings have we made for you; accept them.
paragraphs.original: बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्यर्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtyarvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam |

paragraphs.text: So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.
paragraphs.original: त आ गतावसा शंतमेनाथा नः शं योररपो दधात
paragraphs.translit: ta ā gatāvasā śaṃtamenāthā naḥ śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta

paragraphs.text: 5. May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations.
paragraphs.original: उपहूताः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु प्रियेषु ।
paragraphs.translit: upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu |

paragraphs.text: Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.
paragraphs.original: त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान्
paragraphs.translit: ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān

paragraphs.text: 6. Bowing your bended knees and seated southward, accept this sacrifice of ours with favour.
paragraphs.original: आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभि गृणीत विश्वे ।
paragraphs.translit: ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve |

paragraphs.text: Punish us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.
paragraphs.original: मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन्नो यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम
paragraphs.translit: mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinno yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma

paragraphs.text: 7. Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings, give riches to the man who brings oblations.
paragraphs.original: आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
paragraphs.translit: āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya |

paragraphs.text: Grant to your sons a portion of that treasure, and, present, give them energy, ye Fathers.
paragraphs.original: पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्र यच्छत त इहोर्जं दधात
paragraphs.translit: putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta

paragraphs.text: 8. Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet,-
paragraphs.original: ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासोऽनूहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.
paragraphs.original: तेभिर्यमः संरराणो हवींष्युशन्नुशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु
paragraphs.translit: tebhiryamaḥ saṃrarāṇo havīṃṣyuśannuśadbhiḥ pratikāmamattu

paragraphs.text: 9. Come to us, Agni, with the gracious Fathers who dwell in glowing light, the very Kavyas,
paragraphs.original: ये तातृषुर्देवत्रा जेहमाना होत्राविद स्तोमतष्टासो अर्कैः ।
paragraphs.translit: ye tātṛṣurdevatrā jehamānā hotrāvida stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who thirsted mid the Gods, who hasten hither, oblation winners, theme of singers' praises.
paragraphs.original: आग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वाङ्सत्यैः कव्यैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः
paragraphs.translit: āgne yāhi suvidatrebhirarvāṅsatyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Come, Agni, come with countless ancient Fathers, dwellers in light, primeval, God-adorers,
paragraphs.original: ये सत्यासो हविरदो हविष्पा इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं दधानाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ dadhānāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Eaters and drinkers of oblations, truthful, who travel with the Deities and Indra.
paragraphs.original: आग्ने याहि सहस्रं देववन्दैः परैः पूर्वैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः
paragraphs.translit: āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place.
paragraphs.original: अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गच्छत सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः ।
paragraphs.translit: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.
paragraphs.original: अत्ता हवींषि प्रयतानि बर्हिष्यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं दधातन
paragraphs.translit: attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana

paragraphs.text: 12. Thou, Agni Jatavedas, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant,
paragraphs.original: त्वमग्न ईळितो जातवेदोऽवाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वी ।
paragraphs.translit: tvamagna īḷito jātavedo'vāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī |

paragraphs.text: And give them to the Fathers who did cat them with Svadha. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.
paragraphs.original: प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि
paragraphs.translit: prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi

paragraphs.text: 13. Thou, Jatavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent,
paragraphs.original: ये चेह पितरो ये च नेह याँश्च विद्म याँ उ च न प्रविद्म ।
paragraphs.translit: ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yām̐śca vidma yām̐ u ca na pravidma |

paragraphs.text: Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not: accept the sacrifice well prepared with portions.
paragraphs.original: त्वं वेत्थ यति ते जातवेदः स्वधाभिर्यज्ञं सुकृतं जुषस्व
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva

paragraphs.text: 14. They who, consumed by fire or not cremated, joy in their offering in the midst of heaven,-
paragraphs.original: ये अग्निदग्धा ये अनग्निदग्धा मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते ।
paragraphs.translit: ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante |

paragraphs.text: Grant them, O Sovran Lord, the world of spirits and their own body, as thy pleasure wills it.
paragraphs.original: तेभिः स्वराळसुनीतिमेतां यथावशं तन्वं कल्पयस्व
paragraphs.translit: tebhiḥ svarāḷasunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayasva
